accuracyFlags: Page implies Pass not needed for planning but never states Pass status: add honest line (saving places and the planner are free; DOC data layers need Pass)
'Core place details are bundled and stay readable offline' is correct; make sure it is not described as offline maps (live routing and map imagery need a connection, already stated)

notes: No page-level impressions (below 70) but queries 'camping trip planner' (1 click, pos 1.0, 2 impr) and 'camping planning app' pos 34 show intent.
